title: SIPP material and food-security diagnostics retain Fay-BRR uncertainty
source_unit: SIPP person record by reference month using final person and Fay-BRR replicate weights; household fields remain repeated on person records

observations.period: 2024 reference year in the 2025 SIPP public-use file

denominator.unit: positive-final-person-weight selected person-record/month rows; 379,215 rows read

high_or_marginal_food_security.unit: percent among 321,883 valid age-15-plus person-record/month records

hungry_but_did_not_eat_because_of_money.unit: percent among 62,808 valid food-screen person-record/month records

one_job.unit: percent among 321,883 valid age-15-plus person-record/month records

observations.method: Selected fields were screened with their official status flags and documented age/food-screen universes. Full estimates use WPFINWGT; 240 replicate estimates use REPWGT1–REPWGT240 and Census Fay-BRR variance with G=240 and perturbation factor 0.5.
observations.uncertainty: The reported intervals are design-based Fay-BRR approximations; field universe, reference-period, nonresponse, and person-record limitations remain. Household fields are not household-weighted.
observations.subgroup: Official field universes: rent/mortgage and utility hardship; age-15-plus food-security and job measures; food-screen universe for hunger.
observations.counterinterpretation: The utility and rent hardship shares need not describe the same people; food security and hunger have different universes; one job is not employment quality or schedule control; none of these estimates identifies a dated bill, care event, institutional cause, or political response.

related_sources.claim: Official field labels, status flags, and universes.

boundary: This is a person-weighted, design-based descriptive layer. It does not establish household prevalence, causal effects, exact event timing, time displacement, remedy, trust, political action, or a complete material-to-time-to-care chain.
